notes: The markup is 5x on 30 days, 4.4x on 90 days and 4.7x on 180 days. A voucher is not automatically a small premium: at this reseller it is the difference between affordable and not. At EUR 20 for 30 days this shop is 5x the vendor's own 30-day price; the 360-day SKU at EUR 99 is 3.1x the sum of two 180-day purchases (EUR 32). The 360-day term is the one thing a reseller sells that the vendor's published table does not.
